description.narrative:
Project description: Developing and growing the GALA Queer Archive’s cultural and academic public programming.
Phase 1: October 2023 - May 2024 (where Outcomes fall under 2nd phase - Year 2 - it is indicated) Impact, Overall Goal: GALA’s overall objective is to increase knowledge, awareness and pride in/of LGBTQ+ histories, identities and lives in Africa. Our various project streams are aimed at the general public, queer historians and researchers, academics, artists, writers, queer youth/students, activists. These groups are reached through our archive collections, library, publications and cultural and educational programming.
Expected result 1: Library upgrade: The library space doubles as GALAs offices and is used for seminars, staff meetings, archive students and safe space for students. The funding would be used to upgrade the neglected facilities and increase the number of users. Phase I will concentrate on the sorting of the books and catalogizing them in a digital library system.
Expected result 2: Archive support Continued collecting and preservation of queer history and life stories in South Africa, and the region. Affirming queer lives and countering the growing anti-gender movement. Outcomes: Preservation and storage, processing new materials/archival backlog, making the archive accessible to researchers and
Expected result 3. Cultural Programming Supporting GALA’s Cultural Programming.
Expected result 4: Book publications: Queer Activism in Africa volume 4 Supporting GALA’s upcoming publications, namely, the 4th and final volume of GALA’s Queer Activism in Africa anthology series, and supporting a the final stages of a similar publication focused on refugees in Africa. Outcomes: Supporting the Queer Activism in Africa anthology series, Finalising Queer African Refugee anthology.
